Title: Conversation Designer
Position Summary: We are looking for a Conversation Designer to join our Expert Services Team. Conversation designers create intuitive and intelligent experiences across multiple text and voice channels. Their role is to define conversational experiences that drive business outcomes by meeting the needs of end users. Conversation designers work on collaborative project teams with natural language analysts, business analysts, solution architects, and developers to deliver custom solutions that highlight the unique capabilities of the Kore.ai platform. Designers interact directly with customers to analyze business objectives, advocate for design solutions, and offer mentorship and training that will enable customers to manage their own applications. text:
You need a Conversation Designer who can create intuitive text and voice experiences that balance user needs, technical constraints, and business goals.

I’m Noor Halden, and I bring 6 years of experience in machine learning and natural language work, with skills in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, and pandas. While my background is technical, I’m comfortable working on user-facing language problems, collaborating across teams, and explaining complex ideas clearly.

I’d be interested in helping shape conversational experiences for the Kore.ai platform, especially where strong analysis and design thinking are needed. I’m self-directed, detail-oriented, and used to working with complex systems and language-driven workflows.

If you’d like, I can help assess the conversation flow, identify design improvements, and support clear documentation for both customers and internal teams.
